items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I was playing the Genetsch Players with Celestate... I used to name him Whipple... Freddie Coleman. Yeah, he was in the band.

ctx.x: Well when I joined, I was playing the Genetsch Players with Celestate, well they had nicknames. I came in the band, they all had some kind of nicknames so they didn't know what they called me, you see. So it wasn't God, I just remember what God was. See I used to name him Whipple. You remember Whipple, him, and the funny thing, and the Popeye, well that's what they named me Whipple. And every time they used to call me Whipple or Freddie used to call me Egg all the time. Freddie Coleman. Yeah, he was in the band.…
Well the Celestan band had a lot of guys in it then or was it a small band?
